description.value: Ithaka is a family-owned Greek restaurant open since 2014, serving authentic Mediterranean cuisine from recipes passed down through the family. It holds the distinction of being the only Greek restaurant in North America to serve as a gastronomy sponsor of the Great Greek Wines awards, and claims the largest selection of Greek wines in western Canada. The restaurant operates as a dine-in, takeout, and delivery destination in central Victoria, and also hosts private events and catering.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 66m; stands (4 spaces) at 72m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is a real, open Greek restaurant at 716 Burdett Ave, Victoria. The phone number (250-384-6474) and address match OSM. Takeout and delivery are explicitly promoted throughout the site ('Delivery & Takeout', 'ONLINE DELIVERY & TAKE OUT NOW'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those are null per absence-of-evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational, publicly accessible restaurant in central Victoria with a live website, confirmed address and phone, and active takeout/delivery service.
enrichment_extras.notes: About page notes the original 2014 location was 1102 Yates St; current OSM and website footer both confirm the present address is 716 Burdett Ave.
